title: Relative finite Tor dimension of a perfect complex
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X$ quasi-compact (every open cover has a finite subcover) and $Y$ Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact). Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type (on affine charts the coordinate algebra is finitely generated over the base coordinate ring), and assume that every stalk $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ has finite Tor dimension as an $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}$-module through the stalk map of $f$ [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. If $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then $E$ has finite Tor dimension over $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$ [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension-over].

proof.text: Choose a complex K representing E by essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q. Apply [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] to the scalar restriction of K to get P, its K-flatness and a quasi-isomorphism q. Apply [lem-pc-perfect-relative-tensor-locally-bounded] to these prescribed models to obtain U_x, a_x, b_x and vanishing of all test tensor homology stalks on U_x.

Quasi-compactness gives a finite subcover t of the U_x. Induction on finite sets, starting with [0,0] and extending endpoints by min and max, produces c≤d with c≤a_x and b_x≤d for each x in t. For every y, choose a selected U_x containing it. A degree outside [c,d] is outside [a_x,b_x], so the local theorem makes its tensor homology stalk at y zero. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero makes the underlying abelian sheaf zero; faithfulness of SheafOfModules.toSheaf then makes the module sheaf zero. K,P,q,c,d are exactly the witnesses required by [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension-over]. If X is empty, the subcover is empty and the induction supplies [0,0], with the stalk condition vacuous.

theorem perfect_hasFiniteTorDimensionOver
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) :
    HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E
